headline: Apple Store launches 2026 Back to School offer with up to $150 gift card
summary: Students can snag a gift card worth up to $150 with the purchase of a new Mac or iPad.
details: Apple has officially kicked off its 2026 Back to School promotion, offering students a valuable incentive to upgrade their devices.
Eligible students and educators can receive a gift card of up to $150 when they purchase a qualifying Mac or iPad from the Apple Store.
This promotion is a great opportunity for students to save money on Apple's premium hardware as they prepare for the academic year.
The offer is available now through the Apple Store and participating resellers, providing a timely boost for back-to-school shopping.

headline_marked: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 [[slims down to 4.1mm]] with titanium frame
headline: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 slims down to 4.1mm with titanium frame
summary: Leaked specs reveal the upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra will be incredibly thin and light, featuring a larger battery and improved display technology.
details: Samsung is set to unveil its 2026 foldable lineup, including the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Z Fold 8 Wide. Leaked details suggest significant hardware upgrades, with a focus on reducing the crease and improving durability using a new titanium substrate design.

The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide is expected to feature a 5.5-inch cover display and a 7.6-inch main screen with a wider aspect ratio. It will reportedly measure just 4.5mm unfolded and weigh 201g, making it thinner and lighter than its predecessor.

Camera specifications for the Z Fold 8 Wide include a 50MP main and 50MP ultrawide rear camera, along with two 10MP selfie cameras. The device will also pack a 4,800mAh battery, the largest ever in a Samsung foldable, supporting 45W wired charging.

The Z Fold 8 Ultra is rumored to boast a larger 6.5-inch cover display and an 8-inch foldable screen. It will reportedly feature a triple rear camera system, headlined by a 200MP primary sensor, and a massive 5,000mAh battery.

Despite its larger battery, the Z Fold 8 Ultra is anticipated to be even slimmer than the Wide model, measuring an astonishing 4.1mm when unfolded. Both models will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 'for Galaxy' chipset with 12GB RAM and up to 1TB of storage.
